method: Three alternating fresh Node pairs per scenario; one whole-workload warmup and three timed passes per child. Exact differential outputs checked before timing. Input construction/materialization excluded; output/cache/group creation included. No forced GC or parallel benchmarks.
scope: Standalone splitter/grouping microbenchmark, not React paint, IPC, app startup or whole-app throughput. Legacy flat splitting versus production incremental groups. Natural GC observations cover timed windows only and are descriptive, not a collector performance guarantee.
